text:
Maya K: Quick heads up — candidate CT-314's panel on Thu 11:00am PST: Alex just flagged a conflict and can't make it. Can we reshuffle?
Recruiting Bot: Interview CT-314 scheduled — Thu 11:00am PST. Panel: Maya K, Alex Gomez, Samir Patel, Jordan R. Prep doc: https://redwood.app/ct-314/prep
Maya K: @Alex any chance you can move it or swap with another slot?
Alex Gomez: Sorry — travel that day. I can do Fri 9:00am PST or Tue 2:30pm PST. If neither works, I can suggest another interviewer.
Samir Patel: Fri 9:00am PST works for me.
Jordan R: Tue afternoon preferable for me, but I can make Fri if needed. One quick rubric q: in the prep doc there are two variants for System Design — is variant B deprecated?
Maya K: Good call. Variant B is old; we should use the consolidated rubric (Variant A). I'll paste the exact scoring we want below:
```
System Design (consolidated rubric):
- Problem framing: 1-5
- Tradeoffs & constraints: 1-5
- API/SE design: 1-5
- Communication & collaboration: 1-5
Total: avg score; flag major concerns in notes.
```
Maya K: So yes — use the consolidated rubric (Variant A).
Alex Gomez: If we move to Fri 9:00am PST, can we keep the same panel? @Jordan @Samir?
Jordan R: Fri 9:00am PST is OK for me now. Please send updated invite.
Recruiting Bot: CV uploaded to candidate record: https://redwood.app/ct-314/cv (added by Recruiting Bot)
Jordan R: Can someone drop the CV into the calendar invite or thread? Helps me prep.
Maya K: Done — attached CV to the calendar invite and added prep notes. I'll also add a 20-min debrief right after the interview for the panel. Please add 1-2 line summary + 1-5 scores per competency in the debrief message.
Samir Patel: 20-min debrief invite is perfect. Thanks.
Alex Gomez: Also a quick reminder: use the 'Focused questions' sheet in prep doc so we cover the same signals across candidates.
Maya K: Yup — will ping the panel 30m before as a reminder and include the focused questions link. :white_check_mark: 
Samir Patel: Thanks — lmk if anything else changes.
Maya K: Will do.
Alex Gomez: Thanks all.
Maya K: Closing loop — moved interview to Fri 9:00am PST, updated invites, consolidated rubric. If anyone needs to swap again, comment here and I'll coordinate.
